questions: Were you conscious and aware during the jerking episodes?
Could you respond normally while the jerking was happening?
Did you lose consciousness at any point?
Did you feel confused or unusually sleepy after an episode?
Did the jerking begin suddenly?
Were the jerks rhythmic or repetitive?
Did they affect both sides of your body equally?
Did the jerking occur only when you moved or were startled?
Did you have a fever or feel chilled before the jerking began?
Did you bite your tongue during an episode?
Did you lose control of your bladder or bowels?
Did you have a severe headache, weakness, numbness, or difficulty speaking before or after the episodes?
Have you had similar episodes before?
Do you have a history of seizures or other neurologic disease?
Have you recently started, stopped, or changed the dose of any medication?
Have you recently taken alcohol, recreational drugs, or an unusually large amount of any medication?
Have you recently had vomiting, diarrhea, poor fluid intake, or prolonged fasting?
Do you have diabetes or kidney or liver disease?
Did the jerking start after a head injury?
Are the jerks still occurring now?
